products.product_description: Simple Truth Organic Banana, Strawberry & Apple Fruit Puree with Nonfat Greek Yogurt, 113 g, packed in a laminate pouch, Each case has 6 cartons with 6 pouches per carton. Total of 36 pouches per case.
products.reason_for_recall: Perrigo Company is initiating a voluntary recall of one production lot of Simple Truth Organic Banana, Strawberry and Apple Fruit Puree with Nonfat Greek Yogurt, LOT L8159, best by 08/06/2019 due to improper labeling that does not indicate the presence of milk.
